Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Op 1 (21.1, p0089):** replaced the illusory base — the defined capital-F "Fees" (only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) under "the first Order Form" and the event anchor — with the preferred operative words: "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000." Mutuality sentence untouched.
- **Op 2 (21.3, p0091):** broadened the payment carve-out from "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" to "all amounts due under this Agreement", so Customer's payment obligations generally are not damages.
- Indirect/consequential exclusion (21.2) and all carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP) were mapped as already met verbatim, so nothing was added there. Status remains **deviation** at the **preferred** level.
